note: basis: measured = read back from a billed prediction (Atlas data.price) or an account counter; catalog = list price, not yet verified (catalog prices were wrong by up to 18x); assumed = a working estimate. A model whose basis is not measured runs one probe job first. Override per series in <series>/price-table.json.
